scenario.name: send_message_with_contact_content_cellular_off
deviations_from_public_hepm_runs: no summarize_the_task harness tool (H-EPM injection; absent from official source)
official instruction, initial state, tools and evaluator unchanged

dependencies.strategy: minimal subset actually imported by the pilot chain

route.request_model_note: alias is not an immutable version pin; raw-client string is the alias without the provider prefix and is NOT yet verified against the API
route.api_key_handling: value is never read, logged or hashed by this entry; the worker reads it only in the real-route branch at execute time

retry.counting: logical calls are counted outside the retry loop, per role, before any transport attempt; every attempt inside the loop is counted as transport_attempt_count
retry.official_defaults_and_deviation: official OpenAIAPIAgent tenacity retries requests.exceptions.HTTPError only — the httpx-based openai SDK never raises it, so that layer is a no-op; official OpenAIAPIUser tenacity retries ANY exception; official defaults also stack the SDK's internal max_retries=2 under tenacity. The pilot replaces both with ONE explicit counted layer and sdk_max_retries=0, identical for both roles

budgets.max_messages_note: official Scenario.max_messages is a SANDBOX message-index threshold, not a strict model-request or tool-call cap; one scheduling round may append several messages. The official default 30 is kept and the actual message increment is recorded
budgets.max_tokens: not set (official model_inference omits it; provider default applies). No hard token guarantee is claimed; the budget is enforced by logical-call caps, the shared work deadline and the parent kill

sampling.boundaries: worker writes its own /proc boundary reads at phase edges

topology.worker_process: one subprocess runs agent model client, user-simulator model client, in-process tool execution and the official evaluator
topology.scopes: A agent/harness+model client, B user simulator, C tool execution, D evaluator, E prepare/cleanup all share the worker process; every resource window is a shared-scope window
topology.per_tool_attribution: not supported and not claimed; batch windows are shared_scope_window; per-call execution durations stay unknown
topology.network_boundary: model clients need egress to the route api_base; scenario tools and evaluator are offline (in-memory polars); the process is not network-disabled
topology.hard_deadline: parent monitors persisted actual phase starts and kills the worker at min(phase_start + phase_budget, common_work_deadline); common work origin is before spawn, including imports/setup; total deadline retains cleanup/archive reserve

known_nondeterminism.initial_message_creation_timestamps: base scenario builds MESSAGING rows with timestamps relative to the run clock; IDs are deterministic_uuid(payload) and stable
